SELECT u.id AS id, u.username AS username, u.real_name AS realName, u.phone AS phone, u.status AS status, u.expire_time AS expireTime, r.code AS roleCode, r.name AS roleName, u.create_time AS createTime FROM sys_user u LEFT JOIN sys_user_role ur ON ur.user_id = u.id LEFT JOIN sys_role r ON r.id = ur.role_id WHERE u.deleted = 0
AND (u.username LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.real_name LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%') OR u.phone LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
ORDER BY u.id
